compute_image_text_similarity: compute image-to-text and text-to-image similarity tensors from BLIP2 image and text features across GPUs
itc_loss: compute image-text contrastive loss from image-to-text and text-to-image similarity tensors with label smoothing
itg_loss: compute image captioning loss from BLIP2 prediction scores and input token ids with label smoothing
itm_loss: compute image-text matching loss using hard negative mining and a Q-Former with an ITM head classifier
Blip2Phase1Loss_forward: run the BLIP2 phase 1 loss module to compute contrastive, matching, and captioning losses together
